title: ChatGPT Review (2026)
intro: ChatGPT is evaluated here as a general-purpose LLM assistant — chat, reasoning, coding help, image generation, and custom GPT projects on OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 model family (plan-dependent access — confirm live packaging on chatgpt.com/pricing). Free covers everyday chat with usage limits. Go sits between Free and Plus as a lower-cost paid tier (verify live list price on the vendor site; SoftwareGlimpse does not publish a Go dollar amount without a captured first-party snapshot). Plus is $20/mo for individuals. Business is $25/seat/mo monthly or $20/seat/mo on annual billing with a 2-seat minimum. Pro starts around $100/mo for higher compute and model access. Enterprise is contact sales for admin, security, and scale. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s AI methodology, scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose ChatGPT when a general-purpose LLM assistant with custom projects, connectors, and a clear team upgrade path is the primary job.
verdict: Choose ChatGPT when a general-purpose LLM assistant with custom projects, connectors, and a clear team upgrade path is the primary job. Compare Claude for long-context writing and reasoning style, Gemini for Google Workspace integration, and QuillBot if you only need paraphrasing — not a full LLM. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, usage caps and credit rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: ChatGPT is the mainstream LLM assistant with approachable chat UX and custom GPT projects — low friction for non-technical users. Score from first-party packaging, not hands-on lab testing.
Primary job is general-purpose LLM assistant — chat, reasoning, coding, and custom projects match the llm-assistant cluster strongly. Scored inside LLM peers, not against QuillBot or ElevenLabs.
OpenAI's flagship models and reasoning modes are category-leading for breadth — strong output across writing, code, and multimodal tasks within the LLM cluster.
Custom GPTs, memory, file uploads, and team workspaces add workflow depth beyond bare chat — held at 8 vs deepest agent-builder platforms.
Native connectors for Slack, Teams, Google Workspace plus Zapier-style automation — top-tier ecosystem for an LLM assistant.
Business and Enterprise publish admin controls and data policies; deepest governance is sales-gated. Strong for mid-market teams at Business tier.
Clear Free → Go → Plus → Business → Pro → Enterprise ladder supports individual through enterprise scale; 2-seat Business minimum is the main micro-team friction.
Free tier and $20 Plus are competitive entry points; Business 2-seat minimum and Pro pricing raise TCO for small teams. Capability justifies spend at scale. Affiliate economics excluded.
Flagship OpenAI models, reasoning modes, and image generation on paid tiers — among the strongest model capability in the LLM cluster.
